mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has climbed 11 points over three weeks, signalling that commuting and office routines are resuming; the return of weekday foot traffic into commercial districts mechanically lifts RETAIL_REC over the following four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose from -23.4 at t-3w to -12.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is not higher than its last-28-day mean in episodes where WORKPLACES improves by at least 5 points over three consecutive weekly readings.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week PARKS drop of more than 8 points marks a self-protective withdrawal from out-of-home activity; households that abruptly cut outdoor trips also cut discretionary shopping, pulling RETAIL_REC lower within one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean falls more than 8.0 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell 9.0 points from -11.1 at t-2w to -20.1 at t-1w
failure_condition: In weeks when PARKS falls more than 8.0 points week-on-week, the following 7-day RETAIL_REC mean exceeds the preceding 7-day mean in more than half of the observed instances.

mechanism_narrative: Joint recovery in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES is necessary for a durable retail rebound: transit volume supplies physical access to retail districts and workplace presence supplies weekday demand, so RETAIL_REC rises only when both series improve together.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT -22.6 to -18.6 and WORKPLACES -23.4 to -12.4 across t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is lower than its last-28-day mean in episodes where TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improved for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When grocery-and-pharmacy traffic runs above baseline while RETAIL_REC stays negative, household spending is being reallocated to essentials; GROCERY_PHARM sustained above +2.0 keeps discretionary RETAIL_REC suppressed for four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean stays above +2.0 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM at +3.1 at t-0w while RETAIL_REC sits at -10.9
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean equals or exceeds its last-28-day mean in episodes where GROCERY_PHARM stays above +2.0 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The fall in RESIDENTIAL from +9.0 to +7.3 shows that time spent at home is shrinking; each point of residential decline releases stored shopping trips, so continued decline predicts higher RETAIL_REC over two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL eased from 9.0 at t-3w to 7.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's mean over the next 14 days is lower than its mean over the last 14 days in weeks when RESIDENTIAL declines relative to the prior weekly reading.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT crossing back above -20 percent of baseline marks restored physical access to retail centres; once that threshold is crossed, RETAIL_REC follows transit higher within two weeks because trip capacity and shopping capacity move together.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean crosses above -20.0 after one or more weeks below it
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT moved from -20.1 at t-1w to -18.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: In the two weeks after TRANSIT crosses above -20.0, RETAIL_REC's mean fails to exceed its mean over the two weeks immediately preceding the crossing.

mechanism_narrative: If a new round of public-health directives sends WORKPLACES back below -20 while RESIDENTIAL climbs, work-from-home orders will strip weekday foot traffic from retail precincts and drive RETAIL_REC lower over the following 28 days.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES weekly mean falls back below -20.0 while RESIDENTIAL rises above +8.0
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES was -23.4 at t-3w while RESIDENTIAL was 9.0
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is unchanged or higher in episodes where WORKPLACES falls back below -20.0 while RESIDENTIAL rises above +8.0.

mechanism_narrative: Late-December Southern Hemisphere school holidays and summer weather raise PARKS visits; the same households making outdoor trips also make discretionary retail trips, so a rising PARKS series predicts higher RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS recovered from -20.1 at t-1w to -13.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is lower than its last-28-day mean while PARKS improves for two consecutive weekly readings during the holiday period.
